notes.title: Version 1.0.0 + Thank you
notes.notes:
Added dragon (including one example armor set).
 Multiplayer: Added free-for-all mode, where each player is against every other player.
 Added ability to upload language translations to Steam Workshop (guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2063591671)
 Fixed issue where armor pieces with blank limbs (ie. chestpiece without arms) would still generate an invisible piece of armor on the respective limbs.
 Fixed issue where limb symmetry would sometimes be enabled even when checkbox is not ticked.
 ItemCreator: Keyboard shortcuts are now disabled while modifying a textbox.
 Improved character spawning to help reduce overlapping with allies.
 Replaced Item Creator skybox.
 ItemCreator: Fixed alignment of certain UI elements.


In addition to the update notes above, I want to give a brief status update.
Firstly, I want to say thanks to everyone who has supported Floppy Heroes. I'm just a random developer who wanted to create something fun, and I'm so happy to see that there are people out there that've enjoyed the game.
Also, thank you to the individuals who have taken the time to provide feedback and suggestions. A number of features were added and bugs were fixed thanks to your feedback.
Thirdly, thank you to those who have shared their custom items with the community on the Workshop. You guys have crafted some really awesome-looking armor and weapons!

On a less positive note: Due to the current situation affecting the world, as well as current sales number, I unfortunately cannot commit much more time to working on Floppy Heroes 2. There were a couple features I wasn't able to implement in time, but overall the game is still a complete experience. I intend to keep an eye on the Community Hub and fix any remaining bugs, but I figured it was fair to let you guys know that the current version of the game will more-or-less be the final version.

Again, thank you to everyone who has supported the game, and I hope you all stay safe during these unpredictable times.

-Rimply

notes.title: Version 0.4.2
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where item chests could not be opened.
Minor tweaks and optimizations to uploading/downloading Workshop items.

notes.title: Version 0.4.0
notes.notes:
Steam Workshop is now available.
Item Creator: Added "Delete Item Project" button.
Battle Setup: Fixed issue with image transparency in loadout thumbnails.
Settings: Fixed refresh rate not being saved.
Settings: Fixed issue where quality preset would not update.

notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Item Creator: Removed trait system, as it made it difficult to achieve interesting stat combinations and take into account certain attributes (such as the item's size and shape). Item stats can now be manually configured using sliders. Existing user-made items will load with default stats.
Due to the removal of item traits, the stats of all official weapons and armor have been updated.
Added keyboard shortcuts to the Item Creator.
Damage numbers now display the team color of the player who inflicted the damage.

notes.title: Version 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Added time limit option to multiplayer. When the timer reaches zero, 'Sudden Death' occurs and every living player will take periodic damage until only one team remains.
Added slow motion and weapon freeze sliders to multiplayer so you can adjust how much players can use them (or disable them completely).
Slightly reduced the accuracy of bots with ranged weapons.

notes.title: Version 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Menus can now be scrolled using the right stick on gamepads.
You can now use the left/right arrow keys to spin, in case you want to play using only the keyboard.
Fixed bug where singleplayer enemies could equip user-made items.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
To make aiming a bit easier I've added a button that, when held down, freezes the rotation of your weapons. This way you can line up your ranged shots, or hold your weapon in front of you while you charge at an enemy. The button is Shift on keyboards, and B or Right Bumper on gamepads.
Slowmo and weapon freeze now each have a 5 second limit, which is represented with blue and red meters (respectively) next to your player icon during gameplay. The meters will recharge when the button is released.
Added "Show Cursor" option to the settings menu. Enabling this will keep the mouse cursor visible and unlocked during gameplay, which may be useful if you're having any cursor-related software issues.
Fixed framerate hiccup when battle starts.
Fixed some stage colliders.
